races.paceDynamic: Mohaaraj looks the natural leader with his prominent style and front-running tendencies, likely to set the early fractions with Law Court and The Joker tracking close behind. With only six runners and most adopting prominent positions, this creates a compact group early with nobody applying severe pressure to the leader. The pace should be genuine but controlled, allowing the field to stay in touch longer than usual. This tactical setup favours horses with finishing kick from prominent positions rather than pure front-runners or hold-up horses.

scenarios.title: Controlled Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Mohaaraj gets an easy lead and dictates fractions without pressure
scenarios.body: The pace stays manageable allowing him to kick clear in the straight, while Law Court benefits from the honest gallop tracking the winner. Both prominent runners can sustain their effort over this trip when not pressured early.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Battle
scenarios.trigger: If Law Court and The Joker press Mohaaraj from the early stages creating faster fractions
scenarios.body: The increased tempo stretches the field and sets up the race for a closer with stamina, bringing Quartermaster and potentially Loblolly into contention. The early pace compromises the front three.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Even Gallop Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes pedestrian with all prominent horses content to wait
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the two-furlong pole where class and recent form matter most. Law Court's consistency gives him the edge in a bunched finish over Mohaaraj who may lack the change of gear.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Hold-Up
scenarios.trigger: If Loblolly gets the perfect trip tracking the leaders who go too fast early
scenarios.body: The front-runners collapse allowing the sole hold-up horse to pick up the pieces despite the tactical disadvantage. Quartermaster could also benefit if getting cover despite his light racing.

races.paceDynamic: City Queen will likely dictate from the front with minimal pressure, as most of this field are prominent runners rather than natural pace pressers. This measured pace profile strongly favours prominent runners who can track the leader and strike late, while the hold-up horses face a significant disadvantage against the likely tempo.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-up Horse Revival
scenarios.trigger: If genuine pace emerges from multiple prominent runners scrapping early
scenarios.body: A strong gallop stretches the field and creates the gaps hold-up horses need to be effective. Guitar Solo and If I Could Dream can unleash finishing kicks from off the pace.

scenarios.trigger: If the favourites fail to handle the tactical nature or going conditions
